actual_file_scope: Author full two-unit proof check with all-ring generation and determinant lifting, fixed-class comparison, shifted Hom lattices and exact formal/Noetherian scopes.
checks: H1 of the scalar positive conormal layers vanishes over every coefficient ring. A specified generating quotient gives H1 of the vector-bundle layers zero using H2=0, so every formal extension lifts all generators.
The same scalar H1 lifts any prescribed determinant isomorphism successively. Pic restriction is injective on isomorphism classes; no uniqueness of the chosen isomorphism is claimed.

Global generators after -Z and target-only Hartogs give F -> P(Z) for a fixed canonical comparison target P, without full-family hypotheses. Relations vanish globally because the Cartier equation is regular on the target.

Relative to the fixed meromorphic determinant tau, the ratio and its inverse are functions on the puncture and both extend to A tensor T; hence the ratio is a unit without assuming the nonreduced ring normal. Adjugates bound both comparison directions by rZ+div(tau)^+, independently of nilpotence.
The integral finite-jet argument applies to Hom(dC), with loss c+(p-1)d, and to product lattices End(2dC). Paired equations give the actual bounded meromorphic Isom scheme of finite presentation.

Every prescribed punctured unit-isomorphism lift through Artin thickenings lies in the same bound. Etaleness and clopen class images follow without coflatness; the comparison scheme need not have a quantitative coordinate bound.
